title: How I Made $1M Building 30 Micro-Apps
description:
Over the past few years, Sanskar has built over 30 products and he just hit $1 million in revenue. In this episode, he shares his exact process for finding product ideas, the marketing strategies that helped him generate $1M, and how he does it all by himself. This is a masterclass in how to build a portfolio of tiny bets!

*Side project ideas you can build with your 9-5:* https://clickhubspot.com/83ig
